To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The high drum level is one of the important factors of boiler abnormal fire extinction in 600 MW unit.

the boiler fire extinguishing is caused by the operators' insufficient attention to the boiler drum level during the time between the unit boiler ignition and the coal mill starting, and that the operators' control capacity is limited.

the high drum level in 600MW unit is caused by the following factors: (1)the high drum level in the boiler is caused by the high water level in the boiler drum; (2) the high water level is caused by the low steam flow in the boiler; (3)the low steam flow in boiler is caused by insufficient combustion of coal.
